_about: Owner: writer of batch B4a (concepts/input-metadata, concepts/cuda-graphs, code/input-metadata, code/prepare-tensor-input-v4, code/prepare-sample-cpp, code/cuda-graph-runner, code/model-runner).

input-metadata.short: The index tensors that the model kernels read in one step: positions, start offsets, cache slots and attention windows. In DeepInfer it is an InputMetadataV4 object.
input-metadata.long: In a prefill step (and a decode step without ZOS) C++ fills the tensors ({{cite csrc/engine/input_metadata/prepare_tensor_input_v4.cpp:391}}); with ZOS a device kernel fills the decode fields. Python wraps them in the dataclass ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/input_metadata/input_metadata.py:218}}).

eager-mode.short: Running the model by launching each kernel from Python, one after the other, without a CUDA graph. DeepInfer runs every prefill step in eager mode.
eager-mode.long: Decode steps also run eager when DEEPINFER_ENFORCE_EAGER=1 or in a PROMPT engine ({{cite deepinfer/worker/model_runner.py:73}}), and before the graphs are captured ({{cite deepinfer/worker/model_runner.py:182}}).

graph-capture.short: The start-up phase that records one forward pass per graph size into a CUDA graph. Later steps replay the recordings.

graph-size.short: The fixed number of query rows of one captured CUDA graph. A decode step uses the smallest size that is not less than its row count.

graph-padding.short: A query row that a decode step adds to reach the graph size. It comes from a placeholder sequence that uses block 0 and state slot 0, and the sampler ignores it.
graph-padding.long: The placeholder is made in {{cite deepinfer/worker/model_runner.py:386-403}}; its state slot 0 is the default of state_id ({{cite csrc/engine/pybind_sequence.cpp:152}}). The padding is added in {{cite deepinfer/worker/model_runner.py:186-190}}.

graph-memory-pool.short: Device memory that holds the temporary tensors of a captured graph. DeepInfer captures the largest graph first, and the other graphs share its pool.

graph-timer.short: CUDAGraphTimer: it measures regions inside a replayed CUDA graph with two sets of events, and it swaps the sets before each replay.
graph-timer.long: {{cite deepinfer/timer.py:78-217}}; C++ helpers in csrc/graph_timer/. NVIDIA only ({{cite deepinfer/timer.py:94-98}}).

sync-guard.short: forbid_cuda_sync(): a scope that raises an error if code inside it makes a torch-visible CPU-device sync. Event.synchronize is not covered. The model runner puts the forward and the sampler launch inside it.

load-plan.short: A list of int32 rows [src_block_id, src_begin, src_end, dst_offset]. A kernel follows it to copy cache entries of many sequences into one flat buffer; src_block_id = -1 writes zeros.

cp-mirror.short: The token order for context parallelism in prefill. Each sequence is cut into 2 × cp parts, and rank r takes part r and part 2·cp − 1 − r.
cp-mirror.long: Made on the device by prepare_for_mirror_cp ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/input_metadata/input_metadata.py:170-208}}). The per-rank pairing is visible in {{cite csrc/engine/input_metadata/prepare_tensor_input_v4.cpp:185-191}}.

sampler-inputs.short: The row indices and per-sequence values that the sampler needs in one step. The C++ function prepare_sampler_inputs makes them from the scheduled sequences.
